purpose: Per-channel conversion audit for AI initial fields. A channel may reach CFD import only when its status is 'verified'; scripts/ai/domino_warmstart_scaling.py::verified_convention enforces this.

model.hashes_rechecked_utc: 2026-11-09; the three model hashes recorded in the plan match

normalization.global_parameters_note: 30 m/s and 1.205 kg/m^3 are reference constants, not learned Reynolds conditioning
normalization.pkl_vs_global_stats_note: Equal within float32 rounding: max |difference| 4.8e-8 over the five min and five max values (probe 2026-11-09, docs/research/domino-warmstart-probe-20261109.json).

identified_by_reference_parity.velocity: U_hat = U / 30 m/s for data at U_inf = 38.889 m/s (so the freestream is U_hat = 1.296)
identified_by_reference_parity.pressure: p_hat = p_kinematic / (1.205 * 30^2), p_kinematic relative to DrivAerML p_ref = 0
identified_by_reference_parity.nut: nut_hat = nut / (30 * L), L = largest bounding-box extent of the STL

operating_point_gate.statement: Using the verified channels at inlet speed U_c assumes Reynolds independence: U = 30 * (U_c / 38.889) * U_hat; p_kinematic = 1.205 * 30^2 * (U_c / 38.889)^2 * p_hat.
operating_point_gate.why_open: Vernon's case runs at 16 m/s (Re about 2.4x lower than DrivAerML); no evidence here tests it. Geometry (Fastback top outside the notchback-only training set) and the CFD-frame transform are separate open items.

evidence_leads.observation: pressure_volume min -2.3051293, max 0.85082501, mean -0.17798688; velocity mean (0.50533861, -0.0011122959, 0.011512947), max |component| about 2.4
evidence_leads.reading: Velocity is already nondimensional. A stagnation maximum of 0.851 fits p/(0.5 rho U^2) with gauge about -0.15 better than p/(rho U^2), which needs gauge +0.35. Hypothesis only; it does not verify any channel.
evidence_leads.resolves_by: Bernoulli fit on upstream inviscid probes (fit_bernoulli / classify_pressure_scale), stagnation probe and far-field U_hat -> (1,0,0), plus same-checkpoint reference parity (plan 6.4)

evidence_leads.source: DrivAerML paper, arXiv:2408.11969 (Section 2, Tables 3 and 4), read 2026-11-09
evidence_leads.observation: pMeanTrim is described as relative kinematic pressure; CpMeanTrim is the static pressure coefficient; freestream U_inf = 38.889 m/s; force files use rho_inf = 1 kg/m^3; x_BL = -2.339 m is 2.346 m upstream of the front axle (front axle x ~ 0.007 m).
evidence_leads.reading: If the training preprocessing divided kinematic pMeanTrim by rho*U_ref^2 with rho = 1.205, the checkpoint follows 'kinematic_over_rho_u_squared' (Bernoulli coefficient 0.415), not either Pa convention. If it divided velocity by 30 m/s while the data were at 38.889 m/s, the far-field U_hat is about 1.296, not 1. Both stay unresolved: the pinned preprocessing revision is not available locally.
evidence_leads.resolves_by: Preprocessing source at the checkpoint's revision, or reference parity using a slice that carries both pMeanTrim and CpMeanTrim (their ratio fixes the source unit).

evidence_leads.source: PhysicsNeMo source tree at 1966d3d (2.3.0a0, not the installed 1.3.0): examples/cfd/external_aerodynamics/domino_nim_finetuning/src/openfoam_datapipe.py and generate_base_predictions.py; globe/drivaer/dataset.py
evidence_leads.observation: The NIM fine-tuning datapipe for DrivAerML divides U by stream_velocity, p by air_density * stream_velocity^2 and nut by stream_velocity * length_scale, with STREAM_VELOCITY = 38.89 and AIR_DENSITY = 1.205. globe/drivaer/dataset.py states U_INF = 38.89 and Q_INF = 0.5 * U_INF^2 as a kinematic dynamic pressure, cross-checked against pMeanTrim / CpMeanTrim at stagnation points.
evidence_leads.reading: Supports a kinematic source pressure divided by rho*U^2. It is a different example and revision from the checkpoint, whose config.yaml names reference 30.00 m/s; the model card text says mean/std normalisation while config.yaml says min_max_scaling. Lead only.

evidence_leads.observation: global_parameters.inlet_velocity.reference = [30.00], air_density.reference = 1.205; data_processor.kind = drivaer_aws; training data paths are cluster paths not shipped.
evidence_leads.reading: The checkpoint's own reference speed differs from DrivAerML's 38.889 m/s. Which value the training preprocessing used for velocity and pressure is unresolved.
evidence_leads.resolves_by: Far-field U_hat from the probe narrows this (consistency only); reference parity decides it.

verification_policy: Probe outputs (Bernoulli coefficient, stagnation rise, far-field level, seed spread, mirror pairs) are consistency diagnostics of the model's own predictions. They may support a hypothesis but never set a channel to 'verified'. Verification needs the exact preprocessing path that produced checkpoint 0.501 or independent same-checkpoint reference parity on a labelled DrivAerML sample (plan 6.4), and is required before any CFD-field import.

probe_runs.environment: AI-3D WSL, torch 2.7.1+cu126, PhysicsNeMo 1.3.0, RTX 4090 Laptop GPU, TF32 off
probe_runs.geometry: TUM DrivAer Notchback full car, six parts, x_m = 1e-3 x_mm (docs/research/domino-warmstart-geometry-v1.json)
reading: Chunking with one global seed: half the points match to float rounding and the other half differ by seed-spread amounts, consistent with a changed random stream rather than an independent chunking effect; not separately proven.

Bernoulli coefficient 0.391 is nearest the kinematic_over_rho_u_squared value 0.415 and far from 0.5 and 1.0. Far-field Ux_hat 1.261 at x = -3.3 m is nearer 38.889/30 = 1.296 than 1.0. Together they are consistent with DrivAerML kinematic pMeanTrim at 38.889 m/s normalised by rho*30^2 and velocity by 30, but the model's own predictions cannot verify this.
The global_stats pressure maximum 0.851 corresponds to Cp about 1.22 under that hypothesis; Cp above 1 can occur at rotating-wheel contact, so it is not decisive either way.
The nose line did not reach stagnation (minimum |U_hat|^2 0.605); its rise 0.422 compares with the Bernoulli value 0.391 * (1.591 - 0.605) = 0.385.
Mirror disagreement is 15-30x the seed spread at the same points, so it is not sampling noise; the asymmetric detailed underbody and the model both contribute and are not separated.
known_report_quirks: stagnation.rise_expected_from_coefficient is coefficient * |U_inf_hat|^2, which assumes the nose line reached zero speed; it did not, so use coefficient * (|U_inf_hat|^2 - min |U_hat|^2) = 0.385 instead.

reference_data.hash_check: all five match the Hugging Face LFS sha256 / git blob ids

reference_parity_runs.preregistered_criteria: fixed multiplier within 5 % of the fitted one and relative L2 error at least 1.5x lower than the runner-up (written into the script before the first run)

labels_only.reading: pMeanTrim is kinematic (density 1) relative to p_ref = 0, and Cp uses 38.889 m/s. The upstream-region median Ux of 35.8 m/s is the car's upstream deceleration, so the q / (0.5 U_upstream^2) ratio of 1.18 is not a density.

nut.reading: consistent with nut / (30 * L), L = largest STL bounding-box extent; nut stays unused

limitations: One run (run_1) and one plane (y = 0); whether run_1 was in the checkpoint's training split is unknown, which matters for accuracy claims but not for identifying units and divisors.
Labels are time-averaged HRLES; error figures describe this sample, not a calibrated accuracy.

Identifies how the checkpoint was normalised for DrivAerML at 38.889 m/s. Using it at another inlet speed (Vernon's case runs at 16 m/s) adds an operating-point scaling and a Reynolds-number assumption that this parity does not test.

import_conversion.why: binds U_norm 30 m/s and rho_norm 1.205 to this audit, takes the gauge in m^2/s^2 only, and refuses the operating-point step while operating_point_gate is unresolved unless Reynolds independence is stated
import_conversion.equations_at_case_speed_U_c: U = 30 * (U_c / 38.889) * U_hat; p_kinematic = 1084.5 * (U_c / 38.889)^2 * p_hat + gauge (16 m/s: U = 12.343 * U_hat, p = 183.58 * p_hat + gauge)
import_conversion.not_for_import: domino_warmstart_scaling.pressure_to_kinematic, a consistency-check helper that accepts any rho and U
import_conversion.plan_6_2_note: The plan's p_Pa = rho * U_ref^2 * p_hat then / rho with U_ref = case speed adds a density division and uses the wrong speed; owner text, not changed here.
